assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-97.
The procedure at issue is CPT 93271.
CPT 93271 corresponds to a cardiac event monitoring study.
A clinical indication note exists and was documented for this episode.
The note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The note documents recurrent episodes of lightheadedness.
These symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks.
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction.
The submitted diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9 and I48.0.
The clinical documentation is consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes.
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
The denied balance of 349.19 is attributable to CPT 93271.
